FieldInformation.Hint: The game's dedicated server (hlds_i686, in the same folder as hlds_amd): it hosts the "Big Battle" mercenary mode for the players of a Counter-Strike NEO server. It has no window; leave it running while people play, and start the game itself from its own profile. On = it registers with the server below, which tells it what to run; players reach it through that server, no port has to be opened. Off = it only starts and waits (nothing tells it to load a map).

The host[:port] of the Counter-Strike NEO server this dedicated server works for (port 3980 if left out); 127.0.0.1 = a server on this PC. The server's operator decides who may run dedicated servers ([match] dedicated). Empty = TeknoParrot's official server, which only takes the dedicated servers its operator has listed.
